jobs.title: Sr Business Systems Analyst
jobs.why: Strong business-systems fit with Audrey's requirements, UAT, stakeholder, workflow, and media-industry experience. The media context makes her earlier background especially useful.
jobs.gap: The role references complex system logic and ad-business platforms, so she should emphasize technical troubleshooting and fast platform learning.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.why: The role emphasizes translating technical concepts into business language, process models and user flows, closely matching Audrey's business-analysis and UX-adjacent strengths.
jobs.gap: The listing asks for 5+ years of business-analysis experience, so Audrey should make the full span of her transformation and requirements work explicit.

jobs.title: Product Analyst (Hybrid NYC / Remote)
jobs.why: Excellent bridge into product operations: customer interviews, business problems, requirements and guidance to product/BA teammates align with Audrey's systems and user-centered background.
jobs.gap: The compensation and guidance responsibilities suggest a relatively experienced hire, so she should emphasize ownership and measurable project outcomes.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.why: Direct business-operations target requiring cross-functional work and analytics, making Audrey's process improvement, reporting, stakeholder and systems background highly transferable.
jobs.gap: She should quantify her analytics and operational impact because the posting explicitly seeks 3-5 years in operations, analytics, consulting or similar work.

jobs.title: UX Designer II
jobs.why: A particularly interesting UX transition because Audrey combines formal UX training with prior media/advertising experience, and the role is at an ad-tech company rather than an unrelated design domain.
jobs.gap: Professional UX-design tenure and portfolio depth remain the biggest risks; the posting should be checked carefully for required years before applying.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.why: The role calls for user flows, wireframes and interactive prototypes, aligning with Audrey's Figma, prototyping, usability and user-centered design training while offering a remote NYC arrangement.
jobs.gap: At this salary level, portfolio quality and direct production-design experience will likely be scrutinized more heavily than her transferable BA experience.

jobs.title: UX/UI Designer
jobs.why: The role's emphasis on experiments, data and reducing user friction fits Audrey's combination of UX training, usability work, UAT and analytical business-process experience.
jobs.gap: She will need a convincing portfolio showing shipped or realistic end-to-end product-design work to compete with candidates already working full-time in UX.
